rationale:
Both deep reviewers marked row 1536 CLOSES again in moved-E at d2a7669902f7e011f51344543b6832839c8b2a85. Sol’s reading: Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24763 “Export bundle is `cmd.chat.export_investigation_bundle`.” “Revoke item is `cmd.chat.revoke_investigation_item`” “`cmd.investigation_context.export_bundle` and `cmd.investigation_context.revoke_item` are retired source spellings” “Open in Terminal is `cmd.terminal.open`” “Open target is `cmd.chat.open_investigation_target`” “`cmd.investigation_context.open_target` is now a retired source spelling like the other two.”
Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:8633 “`cmd.chat.export_investigation_bundle`, `cmd.chat.revoke_investigation_item` | Cataloged command IDs”
Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:22073 “the user rebinds it through the Debug target picker, `cmd.chat.open_debug_target_picker`; `Revalidate target` is offered only where supported” “It records a no-persist route/open disposition and emits no event.”
Plans/Wiring_Matrix.md:482 “| Investigation header `Open target` | `cmd.chat.open_investigation_target`”
Plans/Wiring_Matrix.md:483 “| Investigation header `Export Bundle` | `cmd.chat.export_investigation_bundle`”
Plans/Wiring_Matrix.md:484 “| Investigation item `Revoke` | `cmd.chat.revoke_investigation_item`”
Plans/Wiring_Matrix.production.json:19462 “"ui_command_id": "cmd.chat.open_investigation_target"”
Plans/Wiring_Matrix.production.json:19463 “"handler_location": "handlers::chat::open_investigation_target"”
Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:19125 “Kept: cmd.terminal.open (reveals the exact session's tab, or opens it through the one opening”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24765 “Operation card state transitions for Investigation Context lifecycle-bearing operations, with the ACD-104 blocked recovery path:”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24769 “| `created` | `start` | `running` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24770 “| `running` | `pause_requested` | `paused` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24771 “| `paused` | `resume` | `running` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24772 “| `running` | `needs_attention` | `blocked` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24773 “| `blocked` | `user_action_completed` | `running` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24774 “| `blocked` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24775 “| `running` | `complete` | `completed` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24776 “| `running` | `fail` | `failed` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24777 “| `running` | `cancel` | `cancelled` |”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24779 “It must be a permitted action from `allowed_action_ids[]` on the current blocked episode”
Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24781 “the child owner's states apply instead of `created`” “Terminal command cards take their states from `#section=Status, degradation, and linked-surface behavior`”
The three Investigation Context controls and the terminal control have canonical IDs. The amendment retires the three old spellings explicitly. The operation table includes blocked recovery and delegates child and terminal cards to their existing owners. Astra’s reading: Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24763 gives all four bindings: “Open target is `cmd.chat.open_investigation_target`”, “Export bundle is `cmd.chat.export_investigation_bundle`”, “Revoke item is `cmd.chat.revoke_investigation_item`”, “Open in Terminal is `cmd.terminal.open`”. Chat calls the old export and revoke IDs “retired source spellings: they are not commands, aliases or wiring rows, and nothing dispatches them.” It retires the old Open target spelling in the same paragraph. Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:8633 lists “`cmd.chat.export_investigation_bundle`, `cmd.chat.revoke_investigation_item`”. Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:22073 defines Open target as “A no-persist `navigation_wrapper`”. Plans/Wiring_Matrix.md:482–484 binds the same three IDs to their respective controls. Plans/UI_Command_Catalog.md:18977 ties Open in Terminal to “the exact `terminal_session_id`”. Plans/assistant-chat-design.md:24769–24781 gives nine transition rows from creation through pause, resume, blocking, completion, failure and cancellation, including “`blocked` | `user_action_completed` | `running`” and “`blocked` | `cancel` | `cancelled`”. It requires a permitted cancellation on the current blocked episode and identifies the separate child-task and terminal state owners.
